summary: Lewis Hamilton won the Belgian Grand Prix from P3 on the grid, 0.6s ahead of Oscar Piastri, with Charles Leclerc completing the podium.
Max Verstappen made the biggest climb, from P11 to P4.
Sergio Perez had a day to forget, dropping from P2 to P7.
There were 34 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 2 times.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 78 points over Lando Norris.
